author: Kai Moreno
title: Batch job stuck in queue
content:
# Purpose
Batch API jobs can sit in queued if the dedicated pool is at max concurrency.

# When to use
Batch API jobs can sit in queued if the dedicated pool is at max concurrency.

# What Support does
If other interactive traffic works, this is P2, Support, not a P0 outage. Check the batch status endpoint with them. Do not open a public banner for one stuck job.

# Intake
Collect the customer, the project or pool name, the region if they named one, and the outcome they want. Write those on the SUP ticket before you route.

# Priority and routing
If other interactive traffic works, this is P2, Support, not a P0 outage. Check the batch status endpoint with them. Do not open a public banner for one stuck job. If this page and a more specific SOP both apply, the more specific SOP wins.

# Guardrails
Do not issue credits. Do not disable an org API key from this page. Do not invent a label this page does not name.

# Customer reply
Thanks, we have the request. We will follow the internal playbook for this kind of ticket and update you on the SUP thread.

# Related
Support intake checklist. Severity matrix for anything that is actually down. This page is only for the purpose above.
